cd /work && python3 - << 'PY'
import importlib.util, json, time, resource, sys
def load(n,p):
    s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(n,p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m); return m
mn=load("m","/work/submission/main.py")
n=96; dest=95
pairs=set()
for i in range(dest): pairs.add((i,i+1))
conv=[3+7*k for k in range(13)]
for a in conv:
    pairs.discard((a,a+1))
    pairs.add((a-1,a)); pairs.add((a,a+2)); pairs.add((a-1,a+1)); pairs.add((a+1,a+2))
pairs=sorted(pairs)
edges=[{"u":u,"v":v,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"lab%03d"%i} for i,(u,v) in enumerate(pairs)]
doc={"version":1,"n":n,"capacity":[48]*n,"edges":edges,
     "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":10**6,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,
                "drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]} for _ in range(48)]}
blob=json.dumps(doc)
print("edges",len(edges),"input bytes",len(blob))
t=time.time(); res=mn.run(json.loads(blob)); dt=time.time()-t
out=json.dumps(res,separators=(",",":"))
print("runtime %.2fs out bytes %d (%.1f MiB)"%(dt,len(out),len(out)/1048576))
print("summary",json.dumps(res["summary"]))
print("sig len",len(res["classes"][0]["signature"]),"pathlen",len(res["classes"][0]["candidate_witnesses"][0]))
print("maxrss MiB", resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024)
